lines.zh: 我走得像是有人在背后牵着线。
lines.en: I walk as if someone pulls strings behind me.

lines.zh: 甲胄下面，缝着不属于我的东西。
lines.en: Beneath the armor, something not mine is sewn in.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，关节发出细响。
lines.en: Step by step, my joints make tiny sounds.

lines.zh: 海水从我空着的胸腔里漏出。
lines.en: Seawater leaks from my hollow chest.

lines.zh: 我没有影子该有的重量。
lines.en: I do not have the weight my shadow suggests.

lines.zh: 我绕开地上的裂口，绕得很自然。
lines.en: I avoid the cracks in the ground, quite naturally.
Where I walk, the air turns cold.

lines.zh: 我的手一直在轻轻摆动。
lines.en: My hands keep swaying slightly.

lines.zh: 我记得该往哪一边走，却不记得为什么。
lines.en: I know which way to go, not why.
My tall boot crushes a shell.

lines.zh: 我停下来，像是被人拉住了。
lines.en: I stop, as if something tugged me.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为没有东西催我。
lines.en: I walk slowly; nothing urges me on.

lines.zh: 这里的水比海里浅太多。
lines.en: The water here is far shallower than the sea.

lines.zh: 我的甲上挂着几根海草。
lines.en: A few strands of kelp hang from my armor.
I walk toward where no one is.

lines.zh: 我的头微微偏着，像在听。
lines.en: My head tilts slightly, as if listening.
I stand with unfocused eyes.

lines.zh: 有根线在我肩后，被我扯了一下。
lines.en: A string behind my shoulder; I pull at it.

lines.zh: 我想说话，但张嘴没有声音。
lines.en: I want to speak, but my mouth makes no sound.

lines.zh: 这具身体里住着两个我。
lines.en: Two of me live in this body.
My fingers count their own joints.

lines.zh: 我数着手指，数到一半停了。
lines.en: I count my fingers and stop halfway.
The sea sounds far away.
My chest cavity is full of water.

lines.zh: 我看着自己的影子，觉得不对。
lines.en: I look at my shadow and find it wrong.
For an instant I seem about to wake.
That thought just slipped away again.
I stand a long time with my head tilted.
The droplets on my armor do not move.

lines.zh: 我听见有人叫我的名字，很模糊。
lines.en: I hear someone call my name, blurred.
Your face tightens something in my chest.
Raising my eyes to you takes effort.
Do we know each other?
Do not be afraid; I hardly move.
I cannot recall my own name.

lines.zh: 你站着，我也站着，就这样。
lines.en: You stand, I stand. That is all.
I reach out, then pull my hand back.
My voice is somewhere in the sea.
Can you hear me speak?

lines.zh: 你的体温透过甲片传过来。
lines.en: Your warmth passes through my armor.
The armor splits and water jets out.
I cannot feel the pain.
But I know I am wounded.
Two hundred and eighteen. Thick.
My body tilts.
Something stirs in the seams.
I press the wound; my hand comes away wet.

lines.zh: 这一下让另一个我醒了。
lines.en: That blow woke the other me.
I back off, breathing shallower.
Do not strike again.

lines.zh: 食物在我嘴里没有味道。
lines.en: Food has no taste in my mouth.
There is only seawater in my belly.
You hold it; do not let your hand shake.
I can no longer smell anything.
Such things are useless to the dead.
I reach out only to touch it.
Set it down; I will not pick it up.
I cannot remember what hunger was.
I am not hungry; I just stand with you.
My mouth does not obey me well.
You touched me. Cold, is it not?
I step back; the string pulls taut.
I did not mean to dodge.

lines.zh: 我被撞得贴着墙滑了一下。
lines.en: The hit slides me along the wall.

lines.zh: 我的甲很硬，里面是空的。
lines.en: My armor is hard; inside it is empty.
Another heartbeat seems to tick inside my plates.
I brace on the wall to stay upright.

lines.zh: 我们靠太近了，我看不清你。
lines.en: We are too close; I cannot see you.
Water drips from every seam.
Let me pass; I am going back to the water.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是用来生养的。
lines.en: This body was not made for bearing.

lines.zh: 我记得有人答应过什么。
lines.en: I remember someone promised something.
That person is gone.
I am here, but not whole.
The two of me cannot say such a thing.
My kind are only in the sea.
Do not ask; the wind will carry it off.

lines.zh: 我连自己的手都不确定。
lines.en: I am not even sure of my own hands.
The living should do such things.
I am turning away; do not follow.
I pick up a shard of mirror.
The face in it is not mine.
I let go and watch it sink.

lines.zh: 这枚扣子，是从我甲上掉的。
lines.en: This button fell from my armor.
I close my hand slowly, then open it.
It slips through my fingers.

lines.zh: 我拿起来，忘了要做什么。
lines.en: I lift it, forgetting what to do with it.
There is water, closer than this.
I hold it to my ear and listen.
I set it back where it was.
Something is approaching.
My head turns on its own.
I did not tell it to turn.
I see it, but do not want to move.
The other me is pushing forward.

lines.zh: 我的手臂自己伸了出去。
lines.en: My arm reaches out on its own.
This was not my intent.

lines.zh: 我的脚先于念头迈出去。
lines.en: My feet move before the thought.
Things from the sea know each other.
I am standing in front of it.
I keep watching it.
I stare at it and forget to breathe.
It retreats; I shuffle after.
A string keeps pulling me.

lines.zh: 我举起手，不是我想举的。
lines.en: My hand rises; it is not my wish.

lines.zh: 它绕到侧面，我的头跟着。
lines.en: It circles; my head follows.
Water drips from my seams.
I hear it breathing, very clearly.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离在缩短。
lines.en: The distance between us is closing.
Something pushes at my feet.
My hand falls, fast.
That blow was not mine.
I raise my hand and it backs off.

lines.zh: 这一拳落下去，我听见骨头。
lines.en: My fist lands and I hear bone.

lines.zh: 这一击很重，我也不舒服。
lines.en: That was heavy; I am not comfortable either.
I step back, as if apologizing.
It cried out before I stopped.
I do not look at its face.
Something moves in my chest.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我空白了一瞬。
lines.en: After that blow I go blank for a moment.

lines.zh: 我从水底浮起来，甲里灌满了水。
lines.en: I rise from the bottom, armor full of water.
My first breath is the sea.
I stand in the shallows without moving.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，关节响得陌生。
lines.en: I lift my hand; the joints sound unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 有人在我耳边说了什么。
lines.en: Someone whispered at my ear.

lines.zh: 我记下一个名字，又忘了。
lines.en: I memorized a name, then forgot it.

lines.zh: 甲胄很合身，可我不记得穿过。
lines.en: The armor fits, though I do not recall wearing it.
Kelp wraps around my ankle.
I raise my head; the sky is grey.
I take my first step toward shore.
Flames lick up through my armor seams.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，甲片散了一地。
lines.en: I fall, and armor plates scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我却没有挣扎。
lines.en: Water floods in, and I do not struggle.
The blast flips me; the armor dents.
An arrow passes through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 有咒力缠住我，像另一根线。
lines.en: A curse winds around me like another string.
I am not hungry, yet the body comes apart.
Lightning enters; the armor lights up inside.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我落下去。
lines.en: Nothing below; I fall.
